title: Carry the answering model's identity through to the absorption and score records
body: gating's Verdict carries Model, but the absorption decision record (npq) does not, so the prediction score record cannot either — a later measurement of the absorb threshold across epics can group scores by confidence but not by which model made the guess. Carrying it needs a field on the absorption record and one pass of the predictor's answer into it, then the score record can copy it; without it the calibration set is per-run but not per-model, and nfo's design already speaks of scoring per model.
